label: What is PRIOR_4 to a thing is a cause of its being
paraphrase: OPEN, PRIOR_4 sibling of 70e98bb5: for all y and x, if y is prior to x in being, then y is a cause of x's being (CausesIn y x esse, DEF-CAUSE-OF-PERFECTION at esse). Derived in this batch from the PRIOR_4 sibling of 47aff057 and 5dacb0db (whatever a thing depends on for its being is a cause of its being), which uses no priority term.
